title: The Embedder's Dilemma: LLMs Are Better, but at What Cost?
abstract: arXiv:2608.12875v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Should you replace your text-embedding pipeline with a large language model? We answer this with a controlled, cost-aware comparison of ten LLMs across six families and 26 embedding models (118M to 14B parameters) on 37 tasks spanning classification, semantic textual similarity (STS), clustering, pair classification, and retrieval. In aggregate the two paradigms are effectively tied: the best LLM (Gemini 3.1 Pro, 77.6) and the best embedding model (77.2) differ by 0.4 points. Their strengths differ by task: LLMs lead on reasoning-heavy retrieval, embedding models lead on classification, and the two match on clustering, STS, and pair classification. Reaching that parity is expensive. An LLM costs up to 1,431x more than an embedding model of comparable quality (USD 154 vs. USD 0.11 per benchmark pass), and the open LLMs tested process tokens 2.5 to 736x more slowly on the same GPU. translated_title: 嵌入者的困境：大语言模型更优，但代价是什么？
translated_abstract: 摘要：你是否应该用大语言模型替换你的文本嵌入管道？我们通过一项受控的、考虑成本的比较来回答这个问题，比较对象包括六个家族的十个大语言模型和26个嵌入模型（参数从1.18亿到140亿），覆盖了分类、语义文本相似性（STS）、聚类、对分类和检索等37项任务。总体来看，这两种范式实际上打成平手：最佳大语言模型（Gemini 3.1 Pro，77.6）和最佳嵌入模型（77.2）之间的差异仅为0.4分。它们的优势因任务而异：大语言模型在推理密集的检索任务中领先，嵌入模型在分类任务中领先，而在聚类、STS和对分类任务上两者持平。达到这种平衡代价高昂。一个大语言模型的成本比同等质量的嵌入模型高出多达1431倍（每次基准测试通过的成本为154美元对比0.11美元），而且测试的开源大语言模型在同一GPU上处理令牌的速度慢2.5到736倍。推理令牌占大语言模型推理成本的28%到81%。
tldr: 大语言模型与嵌入模型在整体性能上相当，但前者成本高出数千倍且速度慢得多，因此是否替换取决于任务类型和预算约束。
en_tdlr: LLMs and embedding models perform comparably overall, but the former cost thousands of times more and run much slower, so replacement depends on task type and budget constraints.
